mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Bladework</titleLeft><mainText>Fiora's next attack will slow the target.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Fiora has increased attack speed for the next two attacks. The first attack slows the target, and the second attack will critically strike.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Fiora gains <attackSpeed>@ASPercent*100@% Attack Speed</attackSpeed> for her next two Attacks. The first Attack <status>Slows</status> by @SlowPercent*-100@% for @SlowDuration@ second. The second Attack always critically strikes for <physicalDamage>@AttackTwopercentTAD*100@% damage</physicalDamage>.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Bladework</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has been slowed by Fiora's blade.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Fiora has revealed a <keywordMajor>Vital</keywordMajor> on this Champion. If she hits the <keywordMajor>Vital</keywordMajor>, she <healing>restores Health</healing> and gains <speed>Move Speed</speed>.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Fiora identifies Vitals on enemy champions. Hitting this Vital with an Attack or Ability deals an additional @PassiveDamageTotal@ max Health true damage, grants Fiora @spell.FioraR:PercentMS*100@% Move Speed decaying over @MovementSpeedDuration@ seconds, and restores @PassiveHealAmount@ Health.

Fiora reveals a new Vital after 15 seconds or after striking one.

mBuff.mDescription: Fiora has revealed a <keywordMajor>Vital</keywordMajor> on this Champion. If she hits the <keywordMajor>Vital</keywordMajor>, she <healing>restores Health</healing> and gains <speed>Move Speed</speed>.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Fiora has revealed a <keywordMajor>Vital</keywordMajor> on this Champion. If she hits the <keywordMajor>Vital</keywordMajor>, she <healing>restores Health</healing> and gains <speed>Move Speed</speed>.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipSimple: Fiora has revealed a <keywordMajor>Vital</keywordMajor> on this Champion. If she hits the <keywordMajor>Vital</keywordMajor>, she <healing>restores Health</healing> and gains <speed>Move Speed</speed>.

mBuff.mDescription:
Duelist's DanceFiora has attacked an opponent from their Vital and has received increased Move Speed.
Source: @SourceName@

mLocKeys.keySummary: Fiora lunges in a direction and stabs a nearby enemy, dealing physical damage and applying on-hit effects.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Fiora lunges in a direction and stabs the closest enemy, ward, or structure, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage. The strike will prioritize Vitals and enemies it will kill.

If Fiora strikes an enemy, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced by @CDRefundPercent*100@%.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Fiora Passive</titleLeft><mainText>Fiora deals damage and gains a <speed>Move Speed</speed> boost when she hits her mark.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Fiora reveals all four Vitals on an enemy champion and gains Move Speed while near them. If Fiora hits all four Vitals or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, Fiora and her allies in the area are healed over the next few seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: {{Spell_FioraPassive_Name}} Move Speed bonus is increased to @PercentMS*100@%.

Active: Fiora reveals all four Vitals on a champion for a max of @spell.FioraPassive:RDamageTotal@ max Health true damage and gains {{Spell_FioraPassive_Name}}'s Move Speed bonus while near the target.

If Fiora strikes all four Vitals within @MarkDuration@ seconds or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, Fiora restores @HealPerSecondCalc@ Health per second to surrounding allied champions for @HealDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Grand Challenge</titleLeft><mainText>Fiora has revealed all four <keywordMajor>Vitals</keywordMajor>. If Fiora hits all four <keywordMajor>Vitals</keywordMajor> or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, Fiora and her allies in the area are <healing>healed</healing> over the next few seconds.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Grand Challenge</titleLeft><mainText>Fiora has succeded in her challenge and is healing nearby allies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

Grand ChallengeFiora reveals all four Vitals on the target champion and gains Move Speed while near the target.

If Fiora hits all four Vitals or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, Fiora and her allies in the area are healed over the next few seconds.Source: @SourceName@
<titleLeft>Riposte</titleLeft><mainText>Fiora is immune to all incoming damage and disables.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Fiora parries all incoming damage and disables for a short time, then stabs in a direction. This stab slows the first enemy champion hit, or stuns them if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with this ability.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Fiora parries all incoming damage, disables, and negative effects for @ParryDuration@ seconds, then stabs. The stab deals <magicDamage>@StabDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to the first champion hit and <status>Slows</status> <speed>Move Speed</speed> by @MSSlowPercent*-100@%<attackSpeed> and Attack Speed by @AttackSlowPercent*-100@% </attackSpeed> for @CCDuration@ seconds. If Fiora parries an <status>Immobilizing</status> effect, the stabbed enemy is <status>Stunned</status> rather than <status>Slowed</status>.
